response.sql: WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS spent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), customer_shares AS (SELECT spent, spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(spent) OVER (), 0) AS share FROM customer_spend), shares_with_average AS (SELECT spent, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM customer_shares) SELECT AVG(spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM shares_with_average WHERE share > average_share;
